intended_behavior: Add a new type alias ConcurrentInvocationMode using typing.Literal with values "throw" and "unsafe_reentrant" for reuse in the codebase.

Add a new parameter concurrent_invocation_mode of type ConcurrentInvocationMode with default "throw" to the constructor. Store its value in an instance variable (e.g., self._concurrent_invocation_mode) for use in locking behavior.

Modify locking logic to conditionally acquire the invocation lock and raise ConcurrencyException only if self._concurrent_invocation_mode == "throw". Skip lock acquisition and exception raising when the mode is "unsafe_reentrant", thereby allowing concurrent invocations. Preserve all other existing logic and exception handling.
